description: A native <table role="presentation"> whose rows/cells still resolve to normal row/columnheader/cell roles — role stripping is per-element only and does not cascade down through a table's structure, unlike the ARIA "presentational table" rule (HTML-AAM), which drops the whole subtree's table semantics when the table itself is presentational and nothing else in the subtree carries an explicit table role. Captured as a baseline, not an endorsement. See table-role-presentation-role-aria for the equivalent built entirely from ARIA roles
